Find My Weed

Terms of Service

DRAFT: for counsel review. These terms are a working draft. They are not final legal text.

1. Who can use Find My Weed

Anyone may browse the directory. Cannabis is for adults 21 and older, or 18 and older where state law allows medical use.

Customer accounts are for people who are 21 or older, or 18 to 20 with a medical recommendation where the law allows it. Business accounts are for people who are 21 or older.

2. Licensed businesses only

Find My Weed lists only businesses that hold an active state cannabis license, and shows each license number. A business is shown only while its license is active.

3. Unlicensed cannabis activity is not allowed

You may not use Find My Weed to advertise, offer or arrange cannabis from an unlicensed source. If we find a listing or an account doing so, we may remove the listing or close the account.

4. Reporting an unlicensed seller

Use the "Report an unlicensed seller" link at the bottom of any page. It opens an email to info@keepitil.com. You do not need an account.

We handle every report this way: we confirm we received it within 36 hours; we update you at least every 14 days while it is open; a person reviews it; and we make a decision within 30 days.

5. Business accounts

Before a business can use any business feature, we check its license number, legal business name and category against the state record. One verified account is allowed per license.

A business must keep its listing accurate, including its hours, address and links. The license number is shown on every placement, including listings and any featured or sponsored slot.

6. Reservations and money

Find My Weed is a directory. Where reservations are available, you send a request to the business. The business accepts, changes or declines it.

You settle up with the business in person, at pickup or on delivery. Find My Weed does not handle money from customers, and no card details are collected on this site. The business checks your government ID before it hands anything over.

Fees for businesses, if any, are invoiced separately.

7. Sponsored placements are labelled

Any placement a business has funded is labelled "Sponsored".

8. Content rules

Nothing on Find My Weed may appeal to minors. No health or medical claims are allowed. Listings and other content must not be false or misleading.

9. Fair use of the site

The listings page is open to everyone. You may not use software to copy the site in bulk, such as scrapers, crawlers or other automated tools, except the ordinary indexing that a search engine does under our robots.txt file. You may not copy, republish or redistribute our compilation of listings, or offer it to others, without our written permission.

You may not reverse engineer, decompile or take apart our code, or try to get around any limit, check or access control on the site or its accounts. The public license records themselves belong to the State; this clause is about our compilation and our software.

We welcome good-faith reports of security problems at info@keepitil.com. Researchers who tell us first, and do not harm others or take data that is not theirs, are not in breach of this section.

10. Accounts and ending access

We may remove listings or close accounts that break these terms. You may ask us to close your account at any time by emailing info@keepitil.com.

11. Contact

Email info@keepitil.com.

Not covered in this draft: governing law, disclaimers, limits of liability, disputes, how changes are announced, and how these terms relate to any other terms that apply.
